manifest_entries.summary: Searchable new-thread project picker
Thread-picker group: #4263 + #4257 + #4258 + #4426 + glue
manifest_entries.note:
GROUP entry, built from nix-shared/t3code-thread-picker.toml. These four PRs all
edit the same CommandPalette trio, so combining them here -- against upstream
main -- resolves the combination once against a STABLE base instead of
re-deriving it against a shifting assembled stack on every refresh.

It also gives the add-project flow helpers a home: they are what the four need
to coexist, so they live on the group branch rather than as a stack epilogue.

Rebuild the group first, then pin its new head here.

manifest_entries.summary: Refresh positional model-picker shortcuts when virtualized rows are reordered
Configure centralized or repository-local worktree placement
Separate config, data, state, cache, and runtime storage with XDG/legacy override
Discover Claude models from SDK initialization rather than the fallback catalog
Refresh the sidebar resize cap when the window grows
Drop non-interactive Codex models from the model picker
Keep rapid settings edits from reverting each other
manifest_entries.note:
Two attempts to also close the sub-millisecond response/broadcast gap were
implemented and reverted: `settingsUpdated` carries no revision or correlation
marker, so every client-side heuristic regressed something worse than the gap.

manifest_entries.summary: Recover draft thread IDs after failed bootstrap cleanup
manifest_entries.note:
Under applyPatches this needed a compat patch because
OrchestrationGetSnapshotError and OrchestrationDispatchCommandError have
byte-identical bodies, so `patch` silently landed retryWithNewThreadId on the
WRONG class at this stack's offset. A 3-way merge cannot make that mistake.

manifest_entries.summary: Nix flake: dev shell and desktop package
manifest_entries.note:
Purely additive (flake.nix + nix/README.md), so it carries at essentially zero
conflict cost -- the ideal shape for a permanent-carry topic. Upstream
CONTRIBUTING says they are not accepting contributions and want an issue first,
so this is carried locally rather than opened as a cold PR.

manifest_entries.summary: Complete client-only desktop, pairing, environment presentation, and settings suite
manifest_entries.note:
Canonical cumulative client branch. Subsumes #4444, #4474, #4496, #4505,
#4538, #4548, #4559, #4567, the branch-linked
t3code/show-remote-host-name topic, and the diagnostics work from #4486.
Thread host badges are client-local presentation, default on for every
environment (including localhost), and do not depend on classifying the app as
a local owner or remote client.

manifest_entries.summary: Align settings ownership and environment selection across settings pages
manifest_entries.note:
Moves the shared environment selector into the persistent settings header,
including Environment General, and removes duplicate page-local selectors.
Keybindings are client-owned and client-persisted; Connections remains a
client page; provider configuration, source control, and diagnostics remain
environment-owned.
